title: Welcome flow clarity pass — contrast & icon legibility
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Improve legibility and perceptual clarity of the Welcome/Quickstart flow and accompanying release screenshots for both light and dark themes, focusing on WCAG AA contrast, icon stroke clarity at 16–24px, and photo/screenshot treatment. This ticket covers visual pass, asset export conventions, and handoff notes for engineering and docs.
acceptance_criteria: All primary CTA text meets WCAG AA (4.5:1) in both light and dark themes for default and large text sizes.
System and feature icons used in the welcome flow remain recognisable at 16px and 20px; adjusted strokes and padding where necessary.
Exported .png and .svg onboarding screenshots for docs follow naming convention and include 2x DPR versions for mobile; optimized assets added to onboarding-assets folder.
Design QA checklist completed and signed off by PM and Accessibility reviewer.
Engineering has a clear token map and CSS token names for the color deltas applied in dark mode (tokens documented in attachments).
steps: Audit current welcome/quickstart screens in Figma for contrast ratios and icon sizes.
Create a set of proposed color deltas: elevated-surface, muted-text, interactive-primary, and subtle-divider for dark theme.
Iterate icon set: adjust strokes, add 1px inner padding, create 16/20/24px variants and generate SVGs.
Capture updated product screenshots with feature flags enabled (new quickstart copy) and apply consistent drop shadows/soft overlays for legibility.
Export assets at 1x/2x with descriptive filenames and upload to the onboarding-assets folder; include a JSON manifest for engineering mapping.
Run internal a11y audit (Contrast Checker + NVDA spot checks) and document any remaining issues.
Create PRD note and callout for release notes showing visual changes and guidance for partners embedding screenshots.
Handoff: share Figma file, export ZIP, and create GitHub PR reference for front-end changes.
comments: 2025-02-12 Aisha Patel: Kickoff — ran baseline audit: found 6 CTA buttons failing 4.5:1 in dark theme; system icons look thin at 16px (especially glyphs with diagonal strokes).

2025-02-13 Marco Chen: Proposed color deltas uploaded to Figma. Chose interactive-primary #6EC1FF on dark surface with 4.8:1 as balance between vibrancy and accessibility. Will test with animations off for static screenshots.
2025-02-14 Lila Gomez (PM): Confirmed priority for desktop screenshots used in docs and partner site; mobile variants lower priority but still required for release.

2025-02-16 Accessibility review (Jonas Meyer): Adjusted muted-text from #B3B9BF to #C7CCD0 for 4.6:1 on secondary labels at 14px; recommended keeping dividers >= 1.5px alpha to avoid shimmer in dark theme.
2025-02-17 Marco Chen: Uploaded 16/20/24px icon variants and sample SVGs to Figma; added export tokens and suggested CSS variables: --on-surface-muted, --interactive-primary, --divider-soft.
2025-02-18 QA (Emily Raines): Ran NVDA walkthrough. Noticed button focus ring low visibility in dark mode; created small follow-up ENG ticket ENG-3059 for focus-ring contrast fix.

2025-02-20 Aisha Patel: Finalized screenshot exports and manifest. Drafted release note blurb: 'Improved contrast and icon legibility across Welcome flow for better readability in high-contrast and dark environments.' Awaiting final PM sign-off before merging PR.
